verdict.rationale: Ramp exposes a broad Developer API (Transactions API, Custom Records API, webhooks, OpenAPI schema) and CLI/MCP tooling that returns JSON, which gives an AI-native user programmatic access to pull most of their data in an open format. However there is no documented one-click 'export everything' or account-closure/data-portability guarantee, and some data (e.g., vault card details, certain reports) may not be fully exportable this way. Missing for 10: an explicit full-account data export/closure feature, confirmation of open-format completeness (e.g., all historical records, attachments), and independent evidence of a smooth 'leave with your data' workflow.
